qs.q: Which structural GI disorder involves a portion of the stomach herniating through the diaphragm, frequently leading to gastro-oesophageal reflux disease and heartburn?
qs.e: A hiatal hernia occurs when the stomach herniates through the diaphragm, which commonly leads to GERD and heartburn. Achalasia involves the failure of the lower oesophageal sphincter to relax, causing dysphagia.
